name: Arcadia Planitia
summary: Northern mid-latitude plains with orbital and geomorphic evidence consistent with shallow subsurface water ice. This region anchors the EVA route-planning study.
reference_note: Representative coordinate within the Mars_Nav Arcadia CTX footprint; not a verified ice sampling site.
focus: SWIM4MIM ice consistency; MOLA regional relief; MRO CTX surface context; terrain-constrained routing.

name: Utopia Planitia
summary: Northern impact basin containing landforms and orbital signatures relevant to near-surface ice and periglacial processes.
reference_note: Representative regional coordinate, not a confirmed ice excavation target.
focus: Subsurface ice evidence; terrain context; comparison with Arcadia Planitia.

name: Jezero Crater
summary: Ancient crater lake and delta system explored by NASA Perseverance. Provides a reference case for route planning in sedimentary terrain.
reference_note: Approximate crater location, not the precise Perseverance landing coordinates.
focus: Delta stratigraphy; sedimentary geology; rover traverse context.

name: Gale Crater
summary: Impact crater hosting Mount Sharp and the Curiosity rover mission, with an extensive record of sedimentary environments and habitability studies.
reference_note: Representative crater coordinate, not the precise Curiosity landing site.

name: Valles Marineris
summary: Planet-scale canyon system characterized by major topographic relief, steep escarpments and complex surface access.
reference_note: Representative point within an extensive canyon system.

name: Olympus Mons
summary: Large shield volcano illustrating Martian volcanic landforms and extreme regional-scale elevation contrasts.
